description: Low-level I/O routines providing inline assembly functions for port input/output and memory barriers, targeted at PowerPC architecture, for use in spi-loader component in the OpenWrt project.

methods.name: uint8_t in_8(const volatile uint8_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from a hardware register address using inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_8(volatile uint8_t * addr,uint8_t val)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to a hardware register address using inline assembly.

methods.name: uint16_t in_le16(const volatile uint16_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 16-bit value from a hardware register address using inline assembly.

methods.name: uint16_t in_be16(const volatile uint16_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a big-endian 16-bit value from a hardware register address using inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_le16(volatile uint16_t * addr,uint16_t val)
methods.description: Writes a little-endian 16-bit value to a hardware register address using inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_be16(volatile uint16_t * addr,uint16_t val)
methods.description: Writes a big-endian 16-bit value to a hardware register address using inline assembly.

methods.name: uint32_t in_le32(const volatile uint32_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 32-bit value from a hardware register address using inline assembly.

methods.name: uint32_t in_be32(const volatile uint32_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a big-endian 32-bit value from a hardware register address using inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_le32(volatile uint32_t * addr,uint32_t val)
methods.description: Writes a little-endian 32-bit value to a hardware register address using inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_be32(volatile uint32_t * addr,uint32_t val)
methods.description: Writes a big-endian 32-bit value to a hardware register address using inline assembly.

methods.name: void sync(void)
methods.description: Performs a memory synchronization barrier on PowerPC architecture.

methods.name: void eieio(void)
methods.description: Performs 'Enforce In-order Execution of I/O' instruction to ensure ordering of I/O operations.

methods.name: void barrier(void)
methods.description: A no-operation memory barrier for compiler optimization prevention.

ctags.name: out_8
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void out_8(volatile uint8_t *addr, uint8_t val)$/

ctags.name: out_be16
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void out_be16(volatile uint16_t *addr, uint16_t val)$/

ctags.name: out_be32
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void out_be32(volatile uint32_t *addr, uint32_t val)$/

ctags.name: out_le16
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void out_le16(volatile uint16_t *addr, uint16_t val)$/

ctags.name: out_le32
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void out_le32(volatile uint32_t *addr, uint32_t val)$/
